topic: Collect Partial Fees and Head-wise Fees
summary: This topic details how to collect a partial amount of the total fee or specific amounts for individual fee heads, allowing for flexible payment options.
steps: On the Collect Fee page, select the desired month(s).
To collect a partial amount for the selected month(s), enter the reduced amount in the total field. The system will automatically deduct from the first fee head.
To manually adjust amounts for individual fee heads, edit the amount displayed for each head (e.g., Admission Fee, Tuition Fee).
To collect only specific fee heads, un-tick the checkboxes for the heads you do not wish to collect.
business_rules: If a reduced total amount is entered, the system automatically deducts from the first fee head listed.
Users have the option to manually edit amounts for individual fee heads.
important_notes: This feature allows for flexible fee collection based on parent's payment capacity or specific payment plans.
questions: How can I collect a partial fee payment from a student?
Can I specify which fee heads to collect money from?
How do I collect only the admission fee and not the tuition fee?
What happens if I enter a reduced amount for the total fee instead of individual heads?
